name: list_users
description: List customer accounts registered in the store. Returns a paginated collection of user objects including their unique identifier, full display name, primary email address, ISO country code, and account creation timestamp. Use the page parameter to iterate through all result pages; check total_pages in the response to know when to stop.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting from 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Number of results per page, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100.

name: get_user
description: Retrieve a single customer account by its unique numeric identifier. Returns the full user object with id, name, email, country and created_at fields.

user_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the user to retrieve.

name: list_orders
description: List orders placed in the store for reporting and analytics. Returns paginated order objects with user id, product id, quantity, unit price, total, status and created_at. Supports filtering by user_id and status.

user_id.description: Only return orders placed by this user id.

status.description: Only return orders in this fulfillment status.

name: get_order
description: Retrieve a single order by its unique numeric identifier.

order_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the order.

name: list_products
description: List products available in the store catalog. Returns paginated product objects with id, name, category and price.

name: get_product
description: Retrieve a single product from the catalog by id.

name: github_list_repos
description: List repositories for a GitHub user or organization.

name: github_get_repo
description: Get a single GitHub repository by owner and name.

name: github_list_issues
description: List issues in a repository with optional state filter.

name: slack_post_message
description: Post a message to a Slack channel.

name: slack_list_channels
description: List Slack channels the bot can see.

name: search_docs
description: Full-text search across the documentation corpus. Returns ranked snippets.
